questions.stem: What determines the pitch of a sound?
questions.explanation: The pitch of a sound is determined by its frequency. A higher frequency produces a higher pitch, and a lower frequency produces a lower pitch. Amplitude determines loudness, not pitch.

questions.stem: Why can sound not travel through a vacuum?

options.text: Sound needs particles to vibrate and a vacuum has no particles
Sound waves are absorbed by empty space
The frequency becomes zero in a vacuum

questions.explanation: Sound is a mechanical wave that requires a medium (particles) to travel through. In a vacuum there are no particles to vibrate, so sound cannot propagate. This is why there is no sound in space.
